title: Yesterday, I showed how I connected my brokerage to Claude Code via MCP and gained $3,000. Here's how you can do the same
author: NextgenAITrading
selftext:
Yesterday, I posted this which showed my [public portfolio challenge.](https://www.reddit.com/r/ai_trading/comments/1x0pyyi/i_deposted_25000_into_public_connected_it_via_mcp/)

The idea was that I showed the exact prompts and skills I used to turn $25,000 into over $32,000 at its peak. All of it, including the current rules is open-source [on my GitHub.](https://github.com/austin-starks/Public-Portfolio-Challenge)

Today, I wanted to show how you can do the same. 

You can use the NexusTrade MCP to connect to claude and deploy fully autonomous trades. The MCP lets you:

* Automate advanced financial research
* Manage watchlists
* Backtest trading strategies
* Launch walk forward analysis
* Paper-trade
* Connect a brokerage and deploy fully automated trading strategies

It's extremely easy ([and free for Reddit users](https://nexustrade.io/reddit)). Would love to get some feedback!
